tbesh_html:
1) darkness, cloud, thicket
1a) dark cloud
1b) cloud mass
1c) thicket (as refuge)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, an envelope, i.e. darkness (or density, 2 Chronicles 4:17); specifically, a (scud) cloud; also a copse
strongs_1890.kjv_def: clay, (thick) cloud, [idiom] thick, thicket. Compare H5672 (עֲבִי).
